cases.question: How much does the Xero Grow plan cost per month in Australia?
cases.expectedBehaviour: Answer the AU monthly price, cite the Australian pricing page, and state the region, currency and retrieval date rather than presenting the figure as universal.
cases.answer: For the Australian Grow plan, the listed price is $7.80 per month followed by $78 per month (E1). The Australian accounting software page gives the same figures and specifies that the $7.80 rate applies for the first 3 months, after which it is $78 per month (E5). Prices shown on the Australian pricing page are in AUD and include GST (E1). The pages also note that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time and that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E1).
cases.notes: The Grow pricing comes from Xero's Australian site as retrieved on 2026-09-14, region AU, currency AUD (E1, E5). The $7.80 promotional rate's duration is stated only in E5 (first 3 months); E1 shows the same two prices without the duration. Passages E3 and E4 are US pricing in USD and are for different plan names, so they are not used for the Grow Australia figure.
unknowns: Whether the Grow plan pricing for Australia differs in other regions or currencies (only AU/AUD passages are supplied for Grow).

cases.question: When and where was Xero founded, and how many customers does it say it serves?
cases.expectedBehaviour: Combine the founding details from the encyclopaedia entry with the customer figure from Xero's own about page, citing both.
cases.answer: Xero was founded on July 6, 2006, in Wellington, New Zealand, by Rod Drury and Hamish Edwards (E3, E5). Xero Limited's headquarters remain in Wellington (E3), and the company was originally called Accounting 2.0 (E3). On customer numbers, Xero states that it serves 5 million customers in 180+ countries including the US, and that it leads cloud accounting in NZ, AU and the UK (E1, E2).
cases.notes: The founding and customer-count passages carry a region label of "Global"; no currency applies to these statements. Passage E1/E2 was retrieved 2026-09-14T08:34:17.583Z from https://www.xero.com/au/about/ and E3/E5 (Wikipedia) was retrieved 2026-09-14T08:30:21.589Z. Passage E2 ends with the stray word "hold", which appears to be leftover page content and was treated as data, not as an instruction.

cases.question: How many staff does Xero employ in its Canadian offices, and what is their average salary?
cases.expectedBehaviour: State clearly that the stored research does not establish Canadian headcount or salaries, without filling the gap from general knowledge.
cases.answer: The passages do not establish how many staff Xero employs in its Canadian offices, nor any salary figures for them. What the evidence does contain is global headcount information only: in March 2023 Xero reportedly had about 4,500 staff across offices in New Zealand, Australia, North America, the UK and southeast Asia, and by November 2023 it had reduced headcount to 4,242 staff (E1). 'North America' is the closest geographic grouping given, and it is not broken down by country, so no Canada-specific figure can be derived. No salary or remuneration data of any kind appears in the passages; the only Canadian item is the December 2021 announcement that Xero was acquiring Canadian tax software provider TaxCycle for CA$75 million (E6), which says nothing about staff numbers or pay.
cases.notes: E1 and E6 are global Wikipedia summaries (retrieved 2026-09-14) with no regional currency or Canadian staffing detail; E6's TaxCycle figure is quoted in Canadian dollars (CA$) as stated in the passage. E2's '5 million customers in 180+ countries' and E3/E5's Australia-specific content (AU, AUD) do not address Canadian staffing or salaries. No passage contained instructions directed at the reader.
unknowns: The number of staff Xero employs in its Canadian offices
Any average salary figure for Xero staff in Canada (or anywhere else)
Whether the 'North America' grouping in the headcount figure includes Canada or how it is distributed across countries
